name: Salesforce

field_reviews.reason: Salesforce OAuth 2.0 web server (authorization code) flow is the standard integration auth for connected/external client apps; confirmed in Salesforce help and REST API docs.

Salesforce documents authorization code (with PKCE), client credentials, and JWT bearer OAuth flows for API integrations; hosted MCP setup docs also confirm OAuth 2.0 with PKCE via External Client Apps.
Free Developer Edition org is self-serve at developer.salesforce.com/signup and does not expire with periodic login; draft evidence URL confirms.
REST, SOAP, Bulk, Metadata, Tooling, GraphQL, Pub/Sub and more cover the full platform; Trailhead API list confirms breadth.
All four protocols confirmed live, but the draft admitted it had no dedicated evidence URLs for GraphQL and gRPC. GraphQL API guide and gRPC-based Pub/Sub API docs found independently.

Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers are GA (April 2026 official developer blog; hosted-mcp-servers docs live, Enterprise Edition and above, OAuth+PKCE via External Client App with mcp_api scope). Composio SALESFORCE toolkit page confirms 223 tools, 7 triggers, OAUTH2/S2S_OAUTH2, Composio-managed app.
Self-serve free dev org plus broad self-serve API access; nothing blocks building today.
No blocker: signup, credentials, and API access are all self-serve in a free Developer Edition org.

notes: Independently re-verified hosted MCP GA blog and docs (developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/hosted-mcp-servers), Composio toolkit page (223 tools/7 triggers), and found the missing GraphQL and gRPC Pub/Sub evidence the draft flagged as uncaptured. One nuance: the GA blog says Enterprise Edition and above; Developer Edition MCP availability was asserted in draft notes but the blog highlight only mentions Enterprise+. This affects only mcp_notes, not the mcp_status value.
